recentItems.description:
🔥 Muqabla Muqabla | 4K Video Song | Humse Hai Muqabala | A.R. Rahman | Prabhudeva Hit Dance 🔥

Relive the iconic 90s dance magic with “Muqabla Muqabla” from Humse Hai Muqabala. Featuring the legendary dance moves of Prabhudeva and the unforgettable music of A.R. Rahman, this evergreen hit continues to be a favourite among Bollywood music and dance lovers. 🎶🕺

Enjoy this 4K video song and revisit the energetic rhythm, iconic choreography and nostalgic 90s Bollywood vibes.

#MuqablaMuqabla #ARRahman #Prabhudeva #HumseHaiMuqabala #90sBollywoodSongs #4KVideoSong #BollywoodDance

Song Title: Muqabla Muqabla

Music Composer: A. R. Rahman

Singers: Mano, Swarnalatha

Lyricist (Hindi): P. K. Mishra

Cast: Prabhudeva, Nagma, Vadivelu, S. P. Balasubrahmanyam

🔥 Why “Muqabla Muqabla” is Iconic:

Introduced Prabhudeva as one of India’s greatest dancers.

A. R. Rahman’s music brought a fresh sound to Indian cinema in the 90s.

Still considered one of the best dance songs of all time.

Loved by fans across generations for its energy and beats.
